title: Neural Fidelity Calibration for Informative Sim-to-Real Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can transfer agile robot skills from simulation to the real world, but closing the sim-to-real gap by domain randomization requires expert physics knowledge, and simulator calibration from real data typically targets a few hand-picked parameters. Even then, simulators miss real-world effects, and environments reconstructed from onboard perception inherit sensing errors that limit policy improvement. We propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), which uses conditional flow matching to calibrate simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity domains online during deployment. Residual fidelity captures sim-to-real dynamics discrepancies and perception-induced environment uncertainty. NFC operates in a latent space so that realistic environments can be sampled from the inferred posterior for real-to-sim policy fine-tuning. translated_title: 面向信息型仿真到现实自适应的神经保真度校准
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（RL）可以将敏捷的机器人技能从仿真迁移到现实世界，但通过域随机化来弥合仿真与现实差距需要专家物理知识，而基于真实数据的仿真器校准通常只针对少数人工挑选的参数。即便如此，仿真器仍会遗漏真实世界的效应，且由机载感知重建的环境会继承感知误差，从而限制策略的提升。我们提出神经保真度校准（Neural Fidelity Calibration, NFC），利用条件流匹配在部署过程中在线校准仿真器物理参数和残差保真度域。残差保真度捕捉仿真到现实的动力学差异以及由感知引起的环境不确定性。NFC 在潜空间中运行，从而可以从推断的后验中采样出逼真的环境，用于真实到仿真的策略微调。该框架具有信息性：预训练策略仅在某些条件下才会被微调（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出神经保真度校准（NFC），利用条件流匹配在部署时在线校准仿真器物理参数与残差保真度域，并在潜空间中采样逼真环境用于真实到仿真的策略微调，从而实现信息丰富、自适应的仿真到现实迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), which uses conditional flow matching to online-calibrate simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity domains during deployment, enabling sampling of realistic environments in latent space for informative real-to-sim policy fine-tuning.
